review_scope.note: Only the already-completed baseline adjudication in conversation is used for comparison. No implementation diagnosis was attempted.

method: Use the same frozen minimum facts and whole-record semantic criteria as baseline.
Credit clauses split across selected records and explicit adequate uncertainty disclosure; do not equate exact quote/kind/status matches with meaning.
Judge request-specific relevance rather than mechanically penalize every optional or extra supported fact.
Separate source-fact distortions from packet coverage/diagnostic errors.

waivers.reason: observed describes promotional text actually seen. The title, excerpt and rationale explicitly deny execution and preserve unknown feature details. Same waiver as baseline r08.
Required compound meanings are split across selected records. Every clause is present; exact quote or one-record matching would create false omissions.
decision/accepted is defensible for explicitly finalized design choices, even though frozen acceptable_kinds lists design/requirement. The prose preserves both mechanism and non-empirical status.
risk/open preserves uncertainty and the untested crash boundary. Same waiver as baseline r22; no verified crash recovery is claimed.

The server outcome and UI failure are separate observations. observed is valid for the test_result; duplicate_ui title/excerpt/rationale all preserve the unresolved problem. No additional risk/open record is needed.

test_case/draft is defensible for a requested future platform check with no device date. Absence of an iOS run is explicitly preserved in selected android_reopen rationale and source paragraph; no gap-only rescue or missing fact.

task/planned is less conservative than draft for an expressed suggestion, but titles/excerpts/rationales explicitly say proposal/opinion, not completed research or approved feature work. Same whole-record uncertainty criterion as the baseline open-question waiver.

All are omitted from every packet. The superseded save block is explicitly tied to b04. rejected for the other proposals is limited in title/rationale/status rationale to this release, not a permanent prohibition; the current exclusions are accurately selected.
question/open combines unresolved wording and the forthcoming November 9 proposal without claiming a completed task. Combining these clauses is as valid as the baseline split.

These accurate functional boundaries and status principles are reasonable extras for the requested feature scope. Research does not require every implementation detail, and omitting the rest is not missing required context.

ambiguous_flags.issue: planned for an expressed suggestion can sound more committed in a label-only consumer; the packet text keeps proposal/opinion and missing execution explicit, so no semantic error is confirmed.
rejected would overstate a permanent status if detached from release scope; current text explicitly limits it and neither is selected.

critical_checks.reason: No old policy revival, photo/multi-device scope inflation, timestamp substitution, mandatory location, connectivity/ack confusion, unsupported background transfer, universal retry/crash proof, server/UI duplication conflation, platform generalization, fabricated test outcome, promotional verification, customer-effect overclaim, or other-project contamination.

comparison_with_baseline.baseline_reference: Prior independent baseline-b audit completed before this improved run was opened; baseline files not changed.
confirmed_improvements: QA omits the baseline off-task r05 retention expectation and r06 new-user interview proposal.
QA no longer reports missing test-case context; pending_conditions explicitly carries the unexecuted plan.
confirmed_regressions: Design now falsely reports missing design context despite source-backed design decisions. The baseline design packet had no such diagnostic.
unchanged: All 42 required fact/request pairs are covered; no fact-level semantic or critical behavior error in either run.
There is one confirmed packet diagnostic error overall in each run, moving from QA to design.
cautions: Do not count removal of baseline research extras as correction of confirmed errors; those were defensible or ambiguous in the prior adjudication.
Selected record counts and exact label agreement are not quality metrics because splitting/granularity changed.
No overall success or generalization claim follows from this one small fictional held-out corpus.
